paragraphs: Rabbi Yonah was so called, as in [Taanit 23b](https://www.sefaria.org/Taanit.23b.9-10), and R' Shimon ben Lakish, as in [Megillah 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.28b.11-13).[^1]

notes.text: Taanit names Rabbi Yonah as an example. In Megillah the comparison comes after two eulogies, one by Resh Lakish and one by Rav Nachman.
